title: Decreto Crestita n.433 02.09.21
body:
TUSCANY REGION
Environment and Energy Directorate
Local Public Services, Energy, Air Pollution Sector
Managerial Decree no. 21934 of 03.11.2022
Subject of the deed: Partial liquidation of commitments undertaken in favour of the company GIDA Spa with DD no. 6630 of 23.11.2005


1.    Framework Programme Agreement for water protection and integrated management of water resources. Supplementary agreement for the protection of the water resources of the Middle Valdarno and the aquifers of Prato and Pistoia.
2.    Commitment Number: no. 9341/2022 
3.    Settlement amount for the year 2022: 275,000.00 / Mandate no. 48448 of 18.11.22


4.    Urgent interventions aimed at resolving the most serious situations of water shortages for drinking water purposes and reducing polluting emissions released into water bodies – L. 36/94 - L.R.81/95
5.    Commitment number: no. 9340/2022
6.    Liquidation Amount Year 2022: 33,131.39 / Mandate no. 48447 of 18.11.22
